asset_set: Questionnaire Q12 option 2 — Auditing company accounts

questionnaire.question_text: Which office role fits you better?

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under ledger and forearms — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; subtle ruled-line suggestion on ledger page via 3 parallel lines max
art_style.mood: precise, tidy desk energy — approachable financial diligence, not a sterile spreadsheet grind
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame

accent.name: sky blue
accent.use: ledger column headers, shirt cuff pinstripe

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: sky blue appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlights on ledger page edge and pen clip
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under hands and ledger base

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: turns a page of the ledger book
left_hand.grip: thumb and forefinger pinching the page corner
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: places a checkmark sticker on a verified line item
right_hand.grip: precision pinch between thumb and index finger
right_hand.position: center-right, hovering over the audit printout

pose.gesture_summary: mid-verification freeze frame — one line item confirmed, moving to next
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

top.sleeve_style: rolled twice to mid-forearm, sharp fold

accessories.placement: resting beside the ledger, not on body

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of forearms works through a neat stack of financial records on a tidy desk. One hand turns a ledger page while the other applies a small green checkmark sticker to a verified line on a printed audit sheet. The scene reads as calm, methodical diligence — the satisfaction of a balanced book, not tedious paperwork.

primary_objects.name: ledger book
primary_objects.detail: open spread with faint ruled columns and a sky-blue header band, no readable numbers

primary_objects.name: audit printout
primary_objects.detail: faint ruled rows suggesting a spreadsheet, no readable text

subject.environment: light desk surface strip across bottom third with neat paper stack edges — fades to transparent at edges

composition.layout: diagonal workflow line from ledger page-turn hand → ledger body → checkmark hand
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 48px safe zone for card crop
depth_layers: background: desk edge only — no wall
composition.thumbnail_readability: ledger silhouette + two hand shapes readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, spreadsheet software brand, letter C, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, cluttered desk chaos, guns, blood

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector illustration, 640x640, transparent PNG background. KursoKo quiz choice for "Auditing company accounts". Style: flat vector, 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, solid fills, minimal cel shadow under hands — matches KursoKo RIASEC sticker family, NO letter, NO border frame, NO text on image. Scene: two forearms at a tidy desk. Left hand turns a page of a steel-blue #5C7A8A ledger with a sky-blue #81D4FA header band. Right hand places a green checkmark sticker onto a printed audit sheet beneath. A violet #4B2C7F pen rests nearby. Crisp white office shirt sleeves rolled twice with sky-blue pinstripe cuff trim. Warm medium skin tone #C8956C. Three-quarter top-down camera, hands in lower half, transparent margins. Mood: calm, precise diligence.
